About me

A little about me

I want to turn what people need into systems that are clear, organized and easy to use.

My path into technology started in senior high school with the TVL-ICT track, where I was named Most Outstanding TVL-ICT student. A work immersion at EonBotz then gave me hands-on time with robotics and web design.

I keep improving my coding by focusing on clean, maintainable work. Outside of class I enjoy traveling, nature and music.

App design · Figma

SeniorCare Navigator

A mobile app concept for looking after seniors. A caregiver can see where they are on a map, check daily health trackers, and a senior can send an emergency alert with two taps.

FigmaUI designClickable prototypeiPhone 15 Pro frames

Screens

  • Sign up and create account
  • Main screen with map, search, and tracker shortcuts
  • Map views with pins and a list of seniors by name and street
  • Caregiver view listing the seniors being cared for

Health trackers

  • Steps: daily count against a goal, a weekly history, calories and distance
  • Sleep: hours slept and a chart of awake, light and deep sleep
  • Emergency button: "Tap twice for emergency"
Close

App design · Mobile

FairPlay

A mobile app concept with a clear message: give the voice of power to women. The design pairs a dark background with purple and gold branding and a justice emblem.

Mobile UIBrandingOnboarding flow

Landing screen

  • Headline "Fight for what is right" with the FairPlay logo
  • Short mission statement and a Sign in button
  • App Store and Google Play badges

Create an account

  • Form for name, age, email and password
  • Sign up with Google, Facebook or Apple
  • Terms of Use and Privacy Policy notice

Desktop app · Java

Tenant Check-In/Out System

A Java desktop program for recording tenants. It stores the tenant's details with a room number and check-in and check-out dates and times, then shows the tenant information on request.

JavaDesktop GUIForms and input handling

Check-in and check-out form

  • Fields for first name, last name and contact number
  • Time and date pickers for check in and check out
  • Room number field and a Confirm button
  • Confirmed details appear as a tenant information summary

Search window

  • Search box to look up a tenant
  • Tenant information panel for the result
  • Check In/Out button

Robotics · Arduino · 2023

Arduino-based car

A small robot car built during my robotics immersion training at EonBotz. It runs on an Arduino UNO and a motor driver module, with a hand-cut body and a sensor housing at the front.

Arduino UNOMotor driverWiringHand-built body

Role

  • Trainee builder during the EonBotz immersion
  • Hands-on robotics and electronics practice

What went into it

  • Arduino UNO as the controller
  • Motor driver wired to geared wheel motors
  • Body cut, shaped and taped by hand
